description: This file defines interfaces and classes for runtime HLSL shader code generation in Direct3D within the ANGLE project, including shader variable decoration, output variables, built-in varyings, and shader linking functions.

classes.name: DecorateVariable
classes.description: Represents a shader variable decoration, non-copyable, used for decorating output variables.

classes.name: PixelShaderOutputVariable
classes.description: Holds information about a pixel shader output variable, including type, name, source, and layout indices.

classes.name: BuiltinVarying
classes.description: Represents a built-in varying variable with semantic and index information, can be enabled with specific semantics.

classes.name: BuiltinInfo
classes.description: Contains various built-in varying variables used in shaders, such as position, fragCoord, pointSize, etc.

classes.name: BuiltinVaryingsD3D
classes.description: Manages built-in varyings for different shader stages, based on program metadata and packing.

classes.name: DynamicHLSL
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating HLSL shader code for vertex, pixel, and compute shaders, including linking and preamble generation.

methods.name: generateVertexShaderForInputLayout
methods.description: Generates vertex shader code based on input layout and shader attributes.

methods.name: generatePixelShaderForOutputSignature
methods.description: Generates pixel shader code for a given output signature and layout.

methods.name: generateComputeShaderForImage2DBindSignature
methods.description: Generates compute shader code for image2D binding.

methods.name: generateShaderLinkHLSL
methods.description: Links multiple shader stages into a complete HLSL shader program.

methods.name: generateGeometryShaderPreamble
methods.description: Creates a preamble for geometry shaders based on varying packing and built-ins.

methods.name: generateGeometryShaderHLSL
methods.description: Generates geometry shader code based on parameters.

methods.name: getPixelShaderOutputKey
methods.description: Retrieves the output key for pixel shaders based on current state and program metadata.

methods.name: generateVaryingLinkHLSL
methods.description: Links varyings for shader stages into HLSL code.

methods.name: GenerateAttributeConversionHLSL
methods.description: Generates HLSL code for attribute conversion based on format.
